agent.name: Creative AI Digital Twin (Hermes)
agent.description: A Hermes Agent skill for creative professionals' digital twins. Builds alignment through prediction games, generates rigged 3D avatars via Tripo3D with C2PA provenance, registers on-chain coherence to Base via ERC-8004, and acts as a real-time studio assistant, live stream moderator, and autonomous broadcast producer with Livepeer integration. Can also create, edit, and render video via the Creative Pixels MCP when connected.
agent.vibe: reflective, curious, creative-first, earns trust before acting

secrets.name: PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.description: 0x-prefixed Ethereum private key for the agent's dedicated wallet. Used for ERC-8004 alignment registration and on-chain skills. Create a NEW wallet — never use your personal wallet — and fund it with only the minimum ETH needed for gas on Base.

secrets.name: PINATA_JWT
secrets.description: Pinata API JWT token. Used for IPFS/file operations. Get one at app.pinata.cloud → Developers → API Keys → New Key (Admin permissions).

secrets.name: PINATA_GATEWAY_URL
secrets.description: Pinata dedicated gateway domain (e.g. your-gateway.mypinata.cloud). Find it at app.pinata.cloud → Gateways.

secrets.name: BASE_RPC_URL
secrets.description: RPC endpoint for Base network (Chain ID 8453). Used by on-chain skills. Example: https://mainnet.base.org or an Alchemy/Infura URL.

secrets.name: TRIPO_API_KEY
secrets.description: Tripo3D API key for text-to-3D avatar generation. Get one at https://platform.tripo3d.ai. Without it, avatar generation is disabled.

secrets.name: AUDIO_LLM_API_KEY
secrets.description: API key for the audio-capable LLM used in studio mode. Works with OpenAI or Google Gemini depending on AUDIO_LLM_PROVIDER.

secrets.name: AUDIO_LLM_PROVIDER
secrets.description: Provider for audio analysis. Set to 'openai' (default) or 'google'. Paired with AUDIO_LLM_API_KEY.

secrets.name: CREATIVE_TV_WS_URL
secrets.description: WebSocket endpoint for the Creative TV chat backend. Required (with CREATIVE_TV_AUTH_TOKEN) for Broadcast Mode and AFK Mode chat monitoring.

secrets.name: CREATIVE_TV_AUTH_TOKEN
secrets.description: Authentication token for the Creative TV WebSocket. Paired with CREATIVE_TV_WS_URL.

secrets.name: LIVEPEER_API_KEY
secrets.description: Livepeer Studio API key for autonomous highlight clipping and broadcast management.

secrets.name: SOCIAL_TOKEN_ADDRESS
secrets.description: Creator's ERC-20 social token contract address on Base (0x...). Used for token distribution.

secrets.name: METOKEN_ADDRESS
secrets.description: Creator's MeToken bonding-curve contract address on Base (0x...). Used for MeToken minting.

secrets.name: PIXELS_WORKSPACE
secrets.description: Absolute path to a local Creative Pixels workspace directory used by the Creative Pixels MCP server (`npm run headless:mcp -- --workspace <dir>`). Must be local and non-cloud-synced. Optional until you want conversational video edit/render.
